[SWS_ANM_00070]
⌈
The Repeat Message State of Network Mode is entered from
Bus-Sleep Mode or Prepare-Bus-Sleep Mode by default, when a logical network is
requested using RequestNetwork method and the NM module shall transmit a NM
message immediately.
